returnDays.title: Return window (days)
returnDays.description: Days after delivery during which a shopper may return an item, unless the item or its condition grade has its own window. 0 = no returns.

warrantyDays.title: Warranty (days)
warrantyDays.description: Days after delivery during which a shopper may make a warranty claim, unless the item or its condition grade has its own. 0 = no warranty.

maxPhotos.title: Photos per claim
maxPhotos.description: How many photos a shopper may add to a claim (0 = none).

reasons.title: Reasons
reasons.description: The reasons shoppers pick from. Empty = free text.

pointsBack.title: Points taken back
pointsBack.description: proportional: in proportion to what is refunded. full_refund_only: only when the whole order is refunded.
